decisions.subject: Production pipeline

options_considered.label: Animated explainer
options_considered.reason: Research-first faceless narration, motion design, captions, and music match the brief.

options_considered.label: Avatar spokesperson
options_considered.reason: Conflicts with the faceless, object-led treatment and would require an unavailable avatar provider.
options_considered.rejected_because: Wrong creative grammar and provider unavailable.

options_considered.label: Cinematic trailer
options_considered.reason: Could deliver mood but is weaker for precise educational definitions.
options_considered.rejected_because: Education, not atmosphere, is the primary promise.

decisions.reason: The animated-explainer pipeline is the production contract that matches the requested research, narration, captions, music, and educational structure.

decisions.subject: Unattended full-run approval policy

options_considered.label: Pause for manual approval
options_considered.reason: Default pipeline policy, but nobody is at the keyboard.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user explicitly instructed self-approval at every gate.

options_considered.label: Print and self-approve each gate
options_considered.reason: Directly follows the user's session rule while preserving transparent gate records.

decisions.reason: The user provided explicit full-run pre-authorization for ranked self-approval, so every gate will still be printed and recorded before continuation.

decisions.subject: Episode 1 concept

options_considered.label: Why Perfect Parts Never Fit
options_considered.reason: Universal maker pain, instant visual hook, and a strong recurring motif.

options_considered.label: The Crack Is a Map
options_considered.reason: Visually dramatic and perfect for episode 2, but slightly narrower for a channel launch.

options_considered.label: One Extra Zero
options_considered.reason: Commercially useful but less tactile for the first five seconds.

options_considered.label: Prototype Is Not Product
options_considered.reason: High-value founder topic but less universal for hobby builders.

options_considered.label: Jugaad That Survives Batch 100
options_considered.reason: Strong regional texture but better after the channel establishes its voice.

decisions.reason: The first-ranked concept communicates its problem without context and establishes the series' failure-evidence grammar.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Available, deterministic, supports bespoke React scenes and word-level captions.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Strong HTML/GSAP motion fit.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine and caption parity is unavailable

options_considered.label: FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: Available and reliable for packaging.
options_considered.rejected_because: Cannot realize the approved bespoke motion-led treatment by itself.

decisions.reason: The brief explicitly requires word-level captions and motion-led bespoke diagrams; Remotion is the only available runtime satisfying both.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Atelier
options_considered.reason: A first-episode hero piece benefits from a one-off visual language and scene-specific compositions.

options_considered.label: Templated
options_considered.reason: Faster and reliable.
options_considered.rejected_because: Would weaken distinctness for the channel launch.

decisions.reason: This is a single hero deliverable where quality and identity matter more than batch reuse.

decisions.subject: Creative renderer family

options_considered.label: Animation-first
options_considered.reason: Physical relationships become visible through custom diagram motion.

options_considered.label: Teacher explainer
options_considered.reason: Clear but would tend toward slides and presenter-like framing.
options_considered.rejected_because: The object, not a teacher, should lead the story.

options_considered.label: Data explainer
options_considered.reason: Useful for stats but the core is a mechanical concept, not a dataset.
options_considered.rejected_because: Wrong primary grammar.

decisions.reason: The learning moment depends on seeing nominal geometry, variation, and clearance move relative to each other.

decisions.subject: Visual identity

options_considered.label: Custom Measured Friction
options_considered.reason: Subject-derived palette, typography, and motion make fit and force tactile.

options_considered.label: Minimalist Diagram preset
options_considered.reason: Accurate and legible.
options_considered.rejected_because: Too neutral for a channel-defining hero piece.

options_considered.label: Flat Motion Graphics preset
options_considered.reason: Fast and social-friendly.
options_considered.rejected_because: Insufficient material tactility and precision.

decisions.reason: The identity maps directly to workshop materials and dimensional fit while avoiding generic explainer aesthetics.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Google Chirp 3 HD Orus
options_considered.reason: Rich male voice, natural delivery, SSML, and configured access.

options_considered.label: Google WaveNet D
options_considered.reason: Cheaper and clear.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less natural for the cinematic forensic tone.

options_considered.label: No narration
options_considered.reason: Free.
options_considered.rejected_because: Violates the brief and weakens the educational promise.

decisions.reason: Voice quality is disproportionately important in a faceless channel, and the premium adds only cents.

decisions.subject: Background music source

options_considered.label: Google Lyria original instrumental
options_considered.reason: Custom mechanical pulse and controlled energy at $0.08.

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free search
options_considered.reason: Free and commercially usable.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less tailored to the motif and act pacing.

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Zero cost.
options_considered.rejected_because: Violates the requested music requirement.

decisions.reason: The custom bed supports the mechanical motif and stays far below budget.

decisions.subject: Hook image provider

options_considered.label: Google Imagen
options_considered.reason: Only configured image provider and strong for one photoreal macro anchor.

options_considered.label: Pure local vector construction
options_considered.reason: Free, deterministic, and consistent.
options_considered.rejected_because: One tactile anchor improves the cold open and satisfies the image asset contract.

decisions.reason: Use exactly one generated image, then keep the rest bespoke and diagrammatic to avoid slideshow risk.

decisions.subject: Provider spend envelope

options_considered.label: $0.15 expected + $0.15 regeneration reserve
options_considered.reason: Preserves a full QA retry while staying dramatically below the $5 cap.

options_considered.label: $0 free path
options_considered.reason: Would require dropping the approved premium narration or original music.
options_considered.rejected_because: Unnecessary quality sacrifice under the available cap.

options_considered.label: $2–$4 generative video path
options_considered.reason: Adds motion clips.
options_considered.rejected_because: The concept is better served by exact deterministic diagrams and captions.

decisions.reason: The approved working envelope is $0.30 with a $5 absolute cap, leaving ample safety margin.

decisions.subject: Narration provider after Google TTS 403

options_considered.label: Local Piper Lessac medium
options_considered.reason: Zero provider cost, reproducible, and technically available.

options_considered.label: macOS system voice
options_considered.reason: Available at zero cost.
options_considered.rejected_because: Flatter delivery and outside the production registry.

options_considered.label: Wait for Google TTS enablement
options_considered.reason: Would preserve the original voice choice.
options_considered.rejected_because: Incompatible with unattended completion.

decisions.reason: Google TTS returned an unbillable policy 403; no retries were spent, and Piper met timing and intelligibility checks.

decisions.subject: Hook image model after Imagen 4 endpoint 404

options_considered.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image
options_considered.reason: Same Google stack, same 16:9 brief, $0.039.

options_considered.label: Vector-only hook
options_considered.reason: Free and deterministic.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less tactile for the five-second paradox.

decisions.reason: The selected image passed the first visual review; no paid regeneration was needed.

decisions.subject: Runtime override after Chromium sandbox denial

options_considered.label: Native FFmpeg frame render
options_considered.reason: Preserves timing, art direction, captions, audio, and budget without browser execution.

options_considered.label: Wait for Chromium entitlement
options_considered.reason: Would preserve the original runtime.
options_considered.rejected_because: Host denied both bundled Chromium and system Chrome; no user was at the keyboard.

options_considered.label: Generated video replacement
options_considered.reason: Avoids local browser rendering.
options_considered.rejected_because: Adds cost and weakens diagram precision.

decisions.reason: Gate G5F explicitly self-approved the runtime contingency under the unattended-session rule.
